items.lede: The announcement likely comes in response to creators' concerns over how easily original content can be copied and redistributed across social media platforms, especially considering how generative AI has made it easier to manipulate existing videos.
items.title: Instagram’s new tool for creators targets unauthorized reposts and AI-modified videos

items.lede: Instagram is beginning to roll out a "content protection" feature that lets creators see and review copies of their videos posted to the platform.
